result.applicability: APPLICABLE: publication must rebuild from latest main, preserve a closed reviewed path set, persist exact identities and side-effect precommit, and keep internal publication evidence separate from behavioral claims.
result.baseline_reason: The protected baseline is current main with single_lineage active, the existing HARNESS_READY artifact, zero observations, and checkpoint inheritance inactive. The publication cannot change runtime behavior or evidence criteria.
result.claim_boundary: Candidate use is limited to publication context hygiene. It cannot convert repository engineering evidence into a checkpoint result, scientist-agent result, family-wide inference, adaptation-loss finding, AGI evidence, or user-level completion.
result.dependency_conflict_status: No Candidate dependency conflict blocks a reversible publication trial. Generation 8 is the sole fenced main writer; the target source/test paths are disjoint from state-only main updates, but every external mutation requires a persisted precommit and fresh dispatch checks.

closed allowlist, reviewed blob manifest, exact branch head and tree
local validation and unchanged exact-head workflow/job identities
fresh generation-8 authority, inbox revision 20, main, PR head, and conflict evidence before merge
expected-head merge result and exact three-path main readback
regression_checks: do not answer or mutate the stale generation-6 invocation
do not include WORK_EXECUTION_STATE, inbox, strategy, prompts, Candidate authority, scratch responses, or foreign-writer records in the publication branch
do not create a branch, commit, push, PR, rerun, or merge before the corresponding durable idempotency precommit and exact readback
do not treat tests, CI, merge, or readback as checkpoint behavioral evidence

risk_dimensions.failure_risk: Moderate: dirty-worktree leakage, stale-main construction, moved head, expired authority, or incomplete readback must fail closed.
risk_dimensions.latency_tokens: Bounded by branch preparation and required CI; unrelated work should not be bundled.
risk_dimensions.quality: Positive only if the exact validated three-path delta reaches main unchanged and remains inactive.
risk_dimensions.tool_external_cost: GitHub branch, commit/push, PR, and conditional merge are authorized only after persisted idempotency records and fresh source checks; no CI rerun unless the exact head has no valid run and a separately precommitted trigger is justified.

result.rollback: Close or leave unmerged only this isolated PR if an invariant fails; never force-push, overwrite another branch, mutate main directly except state-only CAS, or activate the readiness mechanism.
